tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

{"id":"task-14","revision":2,"subject":"单机选人：拟真BP+随机席位+倒计时+推荐召唤师+悬停预览+出装调整","description":"目标：单机选人页加入「真实选人流程」+「推荐召唤师默认」+「召唤师技能悬停预览」+「出装调整」。只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd。

一、随机席位 + 轮流选人（拟真 BP，自选模式叉选）
- 新增字段：sel_player_seat(0..4 随机)、sel_draft_active、sel_draft_step、sel_draft_time(回合剩余秒)、SEL_DRAFT_TURN_TIME=20.0、sel_ally_picks(5)、sel_enemy_picks(5)、sel_taken(已选英雄集合)、sel_summ_manual(玩家是否手动改过召唤师)、sel_stage_ring_label。
- 进入选人页时 `sel_player_seat = randi() % 5`，我方席位/顶部 mini 槽按该索引把玩家放在对应号位（原代码写死 i==0 为我；改成 i==sel_player_seat 的 kind=0），文案「我 · N 号位」。
- 选人顺序（10 步，双方轮流）：我方1 → 敌方1 → 敌方2 → 我方2 → 我方3 → 敌方3 → 敌方4 → 我方4 → 我方5 → 敌方5（seat 为我方号位索引）。轮到玩家席位时由玩家操作，其余由 AI 自动选择。
- 每步倒计时 20 秒（SelRing 中显示剩余秒数、阶段副标题显示「我方/敌方选择 · 剩余 Ns」）；AI 步骤 1.2~2.2 秒后自动选定并推进（同时倒计时照常走）。
- AI 选英雄：从 hero_configs 里扣除已被选走（sel_taken）的英雄，优先补本队尚缺的职责（我方 AI 补齐我方、敌方 AI 补齐敌方），同职责内随机；AI 召唤师用该英雄 hero_configs 里的推荐值。
- 玩家步骤：允许自由点英雄卡预览；点「确定选择」时把当前英雄+召唤师落位到玩家席位；未选英雄则按钮 disabled；倒计时归零自动锁定当前预览英雄（若未选则随机一个未选英雄）。
- 所有已选英雄全局不可重复（叉选）：已选英雄卡置灰 + 顶部标「已被选」，点击只提示不可选（复用/新增一个小提示 label）。
- 10 步结束 → 显示「双方阵容已定」约 0.8s → 自动开始游戏。

二、开局把 BP 结果传进对局（关键）
- `_create_team_ai(team, count, exclude_roles: Array = [], forced_heroes: Array = [])` 新增第 4 个可选参数：非空时优先按该数组顺序造英雄（跳过不存在的），不足再用原随机补齐。现有 3 参调用不受影响（网络 host 路径也必须保持可用）。
- `_start_game(...)` 内改为 `_create_team_ai(Config.Team.PLAYER, 4, [], sel_ally_ai_picks)` 与 `_create_team_ai(Config.Team.ENEMY, 5, [], sel_enemy_picks)`；4 个我方 AI pick 按号位顺序排除玩家席位；开局后清空这些字段。

三、推荐召唤师默认
- 选英雄时（`_on_hero_selected`/`_refresh_sel_preview` 流程）若玩家未手动改过召唤师，则自动选中 `hero_configs[hero]["summoner"]`（25 个英雄是 flash，李白/孙悟空是 smite）；同步召唤师卡高亮、详情、席位小字、顶部 mini 槽。玩家点召唤师后 sel_summ_manual=true，后续换英雄不再覆盖。
- 选人页初始（first_hero 预览时）也应用该默认。

四、召唤师技能悬停预览
- 鼠标 hover 召唤师卡（mouse_entered/mouse_exited）显示浮层 PanelContainer（skin_card，约 380 宽）：技能名(FS_LG 金)、「冷却 120s · 类型 xx · 施法距离 x」(FS_SM 灰)、说明文字（若 SkillDatabase 条目有 description 字段就用；没有就显示「冷却/类型」等已有字段，不要编造）、当前推荐/已选标记。浮层位置跟随卡片（global position + 卡片宽/高 + 16px），clamp 在 2400×1400 内；点击选中时也要同步刷新详情。用 add_child 到 select_ui 根、置顶。

五、出装调整模块
- 底部右栏 520 宽改成两个 tab：「召唤」与「出装」（各 40 高，UiKit.skin_button，选中金 filled）；「召唤」=现有召唤师网格+详情，「出装」=当前英雄推荐出装的 6 件装备顺序列表。
- 数据 API（Lead 已在 assets/ItemDatabase.gd 加好，直接调用，不要改该文件）：
  - 默认推荐顺序：`ItemDatabase.get_recommended_items(hero_configs[hero]["role"])`（6 个 id）
  - 读取自定义：`ItemDatabase.get_recommended_override(hero_name)`（可能为空）
  - 写入：`ItemDatabase.set_recommended_override(hero_name, ids)`（空数组=清除）
- 行 UI：60 高卡片（序号 + 装备名 + 价格，价格用 ItemDatabase.get_item(id)["cost"]）+ 「↑」「↓」小按钮 44×44 调整顺序 + 底部「恢复推荐」按钮；6 行放在 240 高的 ScrollContainer 里。
- 切换英雄时：有 override 用 override，否则默认顺序；改动实时写回 `ItemDatabase.set_recommended_override`（无改动则不写）。提示文案：「该顺序用于对局内推荐出装 / 一键快买」。
- 不改变对局内其它逻辑（UI_Manager 已按 override 取推荐）。

六、保留与验证
- 保留全部既有字段/回调（select_ui/select_summary_label/select_summ_detail/select_confirm_btn/sel_prev_*/_on_confirm/_on_select_leave/_update_confirm_button_style 等）；_on_confirm 由「开始游戏」改为「确定选择」语义（玩家落位），玩家落位后按钮显示「等待其他席位…」并禁用；全部选完自动开局。
- 验证：
  1) headless 解析 0 新增 SCRIPT ERROR（仅既有 Minimap 告警）。
  2) windowed 探针：实例化 battle.tscn → 选人页出现；打印 sel_player_seat、10 步流程日志（谁选了谁、用时）；玩家步骤模拟点英雄卡 + 召唤师 + 确定；把 sel_draft_time 手动改成 0.05 验证超时自动锁定；BP 完成后确认 `_start_game` 被调用且双方英雄与日志里的 picks 一致（可打印 hero display_name + team）；日志 0 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent；截图 2400×1400（含玩家回合倒计时数字与已选置灰卡）保存到 screenshots/select_draft.png。
  3) 悬停浮层：用 InputEventMouseMotion / 直接调用 mouse_entered 信号回调验证浮层出现（打印 panel.visible + rect）。
  4) 出装调整：切到「出装」tab 后打印 6 行物品顺序，点↑↓后顺序变化，恢复推荐后回到默认。
  5) 探针删干净（gd/tscn/uid/截图如需保留就留在 screenshots/select_draft.png）。
- 只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd；不要动 ItemDatabase.gd / UI_Manager.gd / NetLobby.gd / UiKit.gd / HeroPreview.gd。不要弹用户通知（Lead 统一发）。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 实测数据（席位/流程日志/超时/开局英雄）+ 验证结论。","status":"in_progress","blockedBy":[],"writeScopes":["scripts/core/BattleManager.gd"],"ownerName":"select-fullscreen","ready":false,"writeScopeWarnings":[]}

func _check_heroes(snap: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var ally: Array = snap.get("ally", [])
	var enemy: Array = snap.get("enemy", [])
	var heroes := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes")
	if heroes.size() != 10: return false
	var ally_names := []
	var enemy_names := []
	for h in heroes:
		if h.team == 0: ally_names.append(str(h.display_name))
		else: enemy_names.append(str(h.display_name))
	# 我方：玩家 + 4 AI
	if not ally_names.has(str(battle.selected_hero_type)): return false
	for p in ally:
		if str(p) != "" and str(p) != str(battle.selected_hero_type) and not ally_names.has(str(p)): return false
	for p in enemy:
		if str(p) != "" and not enemy_names.has(str(p)): return false
	return true

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Task-10 (completed): full-screen select UI in `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` (3-column layout, backdrop, unified skin). Only modify select-UI functions; do not touch `UiKit.gd`/`NetLobby.gd`/`ResultsPanel.gd`/`NetResultPanel.gd`/`UI_Manager.gd`. Verify headless + windowed probe, delete probe files, report rects.
- Task-12 (completed, revision 3): convert single-player select page to Honor-of-Kings layout — top bar h=92 (allied/enemy 5 mini slots 150×72 + stage block with `_sel_fs(FS_XL)` gold title, `FS_SM` subtitle, 72×72 decorative ring "∞"), middle expand (left/right 176-wide 5v5 seat columns 176×188, center `HeroPreview` in AspectRatioContainer 900:1100 with bottom-left overlay: hero name `_sel_fs(FS_HUGE)*1.5` gold outline, role/recommended-summoner chips, 3 skill chips, bottom-right hint), bottom h=300 (role tabs 112×48 gold-filled active + horizontal hero strip cards 180×112, right 520 summoner 200×64 grid + `返回大厅` 180×92 / `开始游戏` 340×92 gold). Preserve all existing fields/callbacks. Report sent to lead.
- **New task (task-14, claimed revision 2, status in_progress, owner select-fullscreen)**: 拟真 BP 选人流程 + 随机席位 + 倒计时 + 推荐召唤师默认 + 召唤师悬停预览 + 出装调整. Only modify `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd`. Full details in task-14 description (already read). Key points:
  1. Random seat: `sel_player_seat = randi() % 5`; player kind=0 in allied seats/mini slots at that index (not hardcoded 0); label「我 · N 号位」.
  2. Draft order (10 steps): 我方1 → 敌方1 → 敌方2 → 我方2 → 我方3 → 敌方3 → 敌方4 → 我方4 → 我方5 → 敌方5 (index = allied seat). 20s per step (`SEL_DRAFT_TURN_TIME=20.0`); `SelRing` shows remaining seconds and stage subtitle「我方/敌方选择 · 剩余 Ns」; AI steps auto-pick after 1.2~2.2s; player step free preview, press「确定选择」to lock, timeout auto-locks current preview (random if none); heroes globally unique (grey out selected cards + 「已被选」, click shows a hint); after 10 steps show「双方阵容已定」~0.8s then auto-start.
  3. `_create_team_ai(team, count, exclude_roles := [], forced_heroes: Array = [])` add 4th optional param (forced heroes first in array order, skip nonexistent, fill rest by original random). `_start_game` uses `_create_team_ai(Config.Team.PLAYER, 4, [], sel_ally_ai_picks)` and `_create_team_ai(Config.Team.ENEMY, 5, [], sel_enemy_picks)`; ally AI picks = 4 picks excluding player seat in seat order; clear fields after start. 3-arg network host calls must keep working.
  4. Recommended summoner default: if player hasn't manually changed (`sel_summ_manual`) → auto-select `hero_configs[hero]["summoner"]`; sync card highlight/detail/seat/mini; apply initial preview too.
  5. Summoner hover preview: `mouse_entered/exited` floating `PanelContainer` (skin_card ~380 wide): skill name FS_LG gold, 「冷却 120s · 类型 xx · 施法距离 x」FS_SM gray, description only if SkillDatabase entry has `description` field (never fabricate), current recommended/selected marker; follow card + 16px offset, clamp in 2400×1400; add to select_ui root on top; clicking also refreshes detail.
  6. Build adjustment: bottom-right 520 becomes two tabs「召唤」/「出装」(40 high, gold filled active). 出装 = 6 recommended items for current hero: 60-high rows (index + name + cost) + ↑↓ 44×44 buttons, inside 240-high ScrollContainer, bottom「恢复推荐」. APIs (do not modify ItemDatabase.gd): default `ItemDatabase.get_recommended_items(ItemDatabase.get_recommended_items(hero role string))` — actually call `ItemDatabase.get_recommended_items(role)` (role-based fallback, deterministic); read `ItemDatabase.get_recommended_override(hero_name)`; write `ItemDatabase.set_recommended_override(hero_name, ids)` (empty = clear). On hero switch: override if present else default; changes written live; hint「该顺序用于对局内推荐出装 / 一键快买」.
  7. Preserve all existing fields/callbacks; `_on_confirm` becomes「确定选择」(lock player pick), after lock button shows「等待其他席位…」disabled; all 10 done → auto start.
- Verification: headless no new SCRIPT ERROR; windowed probe runs all 10 steps (print who picked whom + elapsed) + player turn click + set `sel_draft_time = 0.05` to verify timeout lock + after BP print both teams' hero names to confirm match picks + hover panel visible + build ↑↓/restore; screenshot 2400×1400 saved to `screenshots/select_draft.png`; log 0 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent; delete probe files; do NOT send Windows notification.
- Report via `send_message({target:"lead"})`: summary + measured data (seat/flow log/timeout/start heroes) + verification conclusion.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, GDScript; project viewport 2400×1400, `window/stretch/mode="canvas_items"`, aspect `expand`; design canvas 2400×1400.
- Autoloads: `UiKit`, `Config`, `ItemDatabase`, `SkillDatabase`, `GameManager`, `UiManager`, `CollisionSystem`, `PathFinder`, `TouchController`, `NetSession`, `SfxManager`, `Vfx`, `PostFX`.
- UiKit: `skin_button(state, accent, filled)`, `skin_chip(accent, alpha, radius)`, `skin_card(accent, selected, alpha)`, `flat(alpha, radius, border, edge, bg, pad, shadow)`, `skin_tag`, `make_backdrop(parent, accent, glow)`; `UiKit.scale()` = max(1, vp.width/2400)*1.35 = 1.35 at 2400.
- Palette: `C_TEXT`, `C_TEXT_DIM`, `C_TEXT_DISABLED`, `C_GOLD`, `C_TEAM0`(0.25,0.85,1.0), `C_TEAM1`(1.0,0.40,0.32), `C_PANEL_BG`, `C_PANEL_EDGE`; font tiers `FS_XS=16, FS_SM=18, FS_MD=20, FS_LG=24, FS_XL=28, FS_HUGE=34`; `_sel_fs(tier)` = `int(round(tier * UiKit.scale()))`.
- `HeroPreview` (`scripts/ui/HeroPreview.gd`, read-only): `class_name HeroPreview extends SubViewportContainer`; `_ready` creates SubViewport (stretch=true auto-resizes viewport to container), `set_hero(hero_name)` (uses `Hero.HERO_MODEL_MAP`, fallback capsule; root Node3D named "PreviewModel" — gets renamed when previous model still queued for free), `set_accent(color)`; not inside ScrollContainer.
- GDScript notes: `AspectRatioContainer.STRETCH_HEIGHT` constant NOT resolvable (use `stretch_mode = 1`, `alignment_horizontal = 1`); warning-as-error for Variant inference from `:=`; containers expand flags; nested class `SelRing extends Control` in BattleManager.gd.
- Data: `hero_configs` 28 heroes (name/role/max_health/attack/attack_range/move_speed/max_mana/skills/summoner/hp_reg/mana_reg); `ROLE_COLORS`; `SUMMONER_DESCRIPTIONS`; `SkillDatabase.get_skill(id)` returns `Skill` with `skill_name/cooldown/mana_cost/damage/type/cast_range` — float props; NO `description` field exists in `Skill.gd`/SkillDatabase (search found none) → hover must use 冷却/类型/施法距离 + SUMMONER_DESCRIPTIONS text.
- `ItemDatabase.get_recommended_items(hero_name: String)` actually keys by HERO NAME (per-hero 3 builds, `randi() % 3` → nondeterministic) and falls back to role pools for unknown keys (roles: 战士/射手/法师/刺客/辅助). UI_Manager calls it with `hero.role` after checking override. So for deterministic default call with role string.
- Probe pattern: temp `_probe_*.gd`/`.tscn`, instantiate `res://scenes/battle.tscn`, wait, find `battle.select_ui` nodes, synthesize `InputEventMouseButton` + `gui_input.emit(ev)`, `await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw`, `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png(...)`, `get_tree().quit()`; run `godot --path . res://_probe_x.tscn --quit-after 1800`.
- Godot binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`.
- Python+Pillow: `C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe`.
- Workspace rules: minimal diff, LF, short Chinese comments, no extra files; do NOT send Windows notification for tasks (Lead handles); working dir `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king`.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` (only editable file; currently 3672 lines, LF).
  - Top fields: line 3 `hero_selected`, line 4 `selected_summoner="flash"`, line 5 `selected_hero_type=""`, line 6 `select_ui`; `ROLE_COLORS` (8-14), `selected_hero_card`/`selected_summ_card` (15-16), `select_confirm_btn`/`select_summary_label`/`select_summ_detail` (17-19), `SUMMONER_DESCRIPTIONS` (21+).
  - `_start_game(hero_type, summoner_id="flash")` line 284: sets fields, frees select_ui, `_create_player_hero`, `_create_team_ai(Config.Team.PLAYER, 4)`, `_create_team_ai(Config.Team.ENEMY, 5)` (lines 297-299) → must pass BP picks.

Extend with 4th param `forced_heroes`.
  - Select-UI palette/fields block 2080-2101: SEL_* colors, `sel_prev_name/role_chip/role_label/info_chip/info_label/skill_box(HBoxContainer)/stats`, `sel_preview_3d: HeroPreview`, `sel_hero_strip: HBoxContainer`, `sel_tab_buttons: Dictionary`, `sel_active_role="全部"`, `sel_seat_hero_label`, `sel_seat_summ_label`, `sel_mini_hero_label`.
  - Inner class `SelRing extends Control` 2104-2123: draws bg circle, dim ring, rotating gold arc; needs countdown seconds display + subtitle updates.
  - Helpers: `_sel_label(text,size,color,centered=true)` 2125; `_sel_fs` 2134; `_sel_btn_style` 2137; `_sel_btn(text,color,filled,min_size=Vector2(560,76))` 2140; `_style_card` 2155; `_sel_summ_name(sid)` 2159 (mapping flash→闪现 etc.); `_sel_skill_type` nearby; `_refresh_sel_preview(hero_name)` 2185 (sets 3D, name, role/info chips, 3 skill chips; should also apply default summoner + build tab refresh).
  - `_show_hero_select_ui()` 2227-2471: root/bg/backdrop/margin(16/8)/page VBox sep8; top 92 (minis loop 2277-2278 with `0 if i == 0`, stage_txt labels 2285-2286 hardcoded「选择英雄」/「自选模式 · 不限时」, ring); mid (our_seats loop 2310-2311 `0 if i == 0`, center preview/overlay/hint, foe_seats); bottom 300 (tab row 6 roles names `SelectTab_<role>`, `select_summary_label` right, strip scroll `SelectHeroStripScroll`, `sel_hero_strip`, right VBox 520 with summoner scroll/grid (`SelectRight`), `select_summ_detail`, `leave` `SelectLeave` 180×92, `select_confirm_btn` `SelectConfirm` 340×92「✔ 开始游戏」); ends: `_update_selection_summary()`, `_update_confirm_button_style()`, `add_child(select_ui)`, `_refresh_sel_preview(first_hero)`, `_refresh_sel_seats("")`, `_rebuild_hero_strip()`.

  - `_on_summoner_selected(id, sname="", card=null)` 2729: sets selected_summoner, styles cards, detail text `"%s · 冷却 %d 秒\n%s"`, summary/confirm. Needs `sel_summ_manual = true` + BP seat/mini sync.
  - `_update_selection_summary()` 2745, `_update_confirm_button_style()` 2763 (gold filled when `selected_hero_type != ""`), `_on_select_leave()` 2785, `_on_confirm()` 2787 (currently `if selected_hero_type != "": _start_game(...)`) — must change to commit BP pick.

- `scenes/battle.tscn` main scene to probe.

## Errors and Fixes
- `AspectRatioContainer.STRETCH_HEIGHT` → "Parse Error: Cannot find member 'STRETCH_HEIGHT' in base 'AspectRatioContainer'" → use numeric `stretch_mode = 1`, `alignment_horizontal = 1` with comments.
- Headless parse "Identifier not found: NetSession" in `--check-only --script` → autoloads not registered; use full headless scene run `--headless --path . res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 45` instead.
- Transient parallel teammate parse errors (TouchActionButton/UI_Manager/Minimap warnings) polluted probe logs mid-task-12; resolved by teammates; final logs clean. Minimap Variant warning is pre-existing/acceptable.
- Task-12 layout overshoot fixes: top bar grew to 100 because stage VBox text min height 86 + panel padding; fixed by setting top stylebox `content_margin_top/bottom = 2` → 92. Bottom grew to 314 because right header + scroll min 108 + 2-line detail 62 + buttons 92; fixed by removing right header → 300. Mini slots were 75 high; fixed via stylebox content margins 2 → 72. Ring stretched to 88; fixed with `SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER` flags → 72.
- `_probe` model lookup null explained: previous model still `queue_free`-pending → new `PreviewModel` auto-renamed; not a bug; viewport had 8 children (env, camera, 3 lights, ring, floor, model Node3D).
- `read_image` unavailable for this model → verify via Pillow pixel stats/file size/rect prints.

- Verify headless + windowed probe (10-step draft log, player click, timeout via `sel_draft_time=0.05`, post-BP teams match picks, hover panel visible, build ↑↓/restore, screenshot `screenshots/select_draft.png` 2400×1400).

- `team_task_update` complete task-14 with current revision (2), then `send_message` to lead with summary + measured data + conclusion. No Windows notification.

- Just finished reconnaissance reads: top fields, `_start_game` (284), `_create_team_ai` (688), palette/fields block (2080-2101), `SelRing` (2104-2123), `_show_hero_select_ui` (2227-2471), mini/seat/card/interaction functions (2473-2715), `_on_hero_selected` (2718), `_on_summoner_selected` (2729), summary/confirm/leave/confirm (2745-2790); ItemDatabase override APIs + `get_recommended_items` behavior; SkillDatabase summoner entries (no description field); UI_Manager override usage.
- No task-14 code edits made yet.

## Next Step
- Edit `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` to implement task-14: add new draft/BP fields (`sel_player_seat`, `sel_draft_active`, `sel_draft_step`, `sel_draft_time`, `SEL_DRAFT_TURN_TIME=20.0`, `sel_ally_picks`, `sel_enemy_picks`, `sel_taken`, `sel_summ_manual`, `sel_stage_ring_label`, plus support fields for hover panel, build tab/rows, hint label, draft timer, AI delay accumulator), randomize seat in `_show_hero_select_ui` and use `sel_player_seat` for kind=0 seats/minis, add draft state machine + 10-step order + 20s countdown/AI auto-pick/timeout/unique-pick greying, default recommended summoner logic, hover panel, 召唤/出装 tabs with build list + ↑↓/恢复推荐 via ItemDatabase override, `_create_team_ai` 4th param + `_start_game` pick wiring, `_on_confirm` → 确定选择/等待其他席位, then verify.

## Critical Context
- Only `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` may be changed; never touch `ItemDatabase.gd`, `UI_Manager.gd`, `NetLobby.gd`, `UiKit.gd`, `HeroPreview.gd`, `NetResultPanel.gd`, `ResultsPanel.gd`.
- Keep all existing fields/callbacks intact; `_on_confirm` semantics changed to lock player pick, but `_start_game(hero_type, summoner_id)` signature preserved (network paths call `_start_game` too — check callers before wiring auto-start to avoid double-start in net mode; single-player draft only).
- `get_recommended_items` is nondeterministic per hero name; use role string for deterministic default (matches UI_Manager behavior); apply override when `get_recommended_override(hero_name)` non-empty.
- Task-12 verified rects (baseline for new layout): top (16,8,2368,92); middle (16,108,2368,976); our seats (16,108,176,976); stage (204,108,1992,976); HeroPreview (800.7,108,798.5,976); foe seats (2208,108,176,976); bottom (16,1092,2368,300); strip scroll (16,1148,1832,244); right (1864,1092,520,300); leave (1864,1300,180,92); confirm (2044,1300,340,92); mini 150×72 at y18; hero card (16,1210,180,112); tab 112×48.

  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

One bundled command inspects the path and every ancestor and repairs the ACL problems it proves in that same run. Expected confinement denials need no ACL repair.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

一、出装 tab 增加「方案选择」
- 选人页底部右栏「出装」tab 内，在 6 件装备列表上方加一行方案按钮：「默认推荐」+ `HeroBuildStore.get_builds(当前英雄)` 里每套方案的名称（最多 6 个，按钮 140×44，skin_button；当前使用的方案金 filled，其余中性）。

二、加载界面（新增组件已就绪，直接用）
- `scripts/ui/LoadingScreen.gd`（class_name LoadingScreen extends CanvasLayer）：

- 改造 `_start_game(hero_type, summoner_id)`：

8: const SAVE_PATH := "user://hero_builds.json"
9: const FALLBACK_PATH := "res://saves/hero_builds.json"
10: const MAX_SLOTS := 6
11: const MAX_SCHEMES := 6
12: 
13: static var _data: Dictionary = {}
14: static var _loaded := false
15: 
16: 
17: static func _ensure_loaded() -> void:
18: 	if _loaded:
19: 		return
20: 	_loaded = true
21: 	for p in [SAVE_PATH, FALLBACK_PATH]:
22: 		if not FileAccess.file_exists(p):
23: 			continue
24: 		var f := FileAccess.open(p, FileAccess.READ)
25: 		if f == null:
26: 			continue
27: 		var txt := f.get_as_text()
28: 		f.close()
29: 		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
30: 		if parsed is Dictionary:
31: 			_data = parsed
32: 			return
33: 
34: 
35: static func _flush() -> void:
36: 	var txt := JSON.stringify(_data, "\t")
37: 	var f := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
38: 	if f != null:
39: 		f.store_string(txt)
40: 		f.close()
41: 		return
42: 	# 受限环境（如编辑器沙箱）user:// 不可写 → 退回项目内 saves/
43: 	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("res://saves")
44: 	var f2 := FileAccess.open(FALLBACK_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
45: 	if f2 != null:
46: 		f2.store_string(txt)
47: 		f2.close()
48: 
49: 
50: ## 某英雄已保存的方案列表：[{ "name": String, "items": Array }]
51: static func get_builds(hero_name: String) -> Array:
52: 	_ensure_loaded()
53: 	var list: Array = _data.get(hero_name, [])
54: 	var out: Array = []
55: 	for b in list:
56: 		if b is Dictionary:
57: 			out.append({"name": str(b.get("name", "")), "items": (b.get("items", []) as Array).duplicate()})
58: 	return out
59: 
60: 
61: ## 保存/覆盖同名方案；返回 "" 表示成功，否则为错误提示
62: static func save_build(hero_name: String, build_name: String, items: Array) -> String:
63: 	_ensure_loaded()
64: 	var clean_name := build_name.strip_edges()
65: 	if hero_name == "":
66: 		return "未选择英雄"
67: 	if clean_name == "":
68: 		return "方案名不能为空"
69: 	var clean_items: Array = []
70: 	for it in items:
71: 		var id := str(it)
72: 		if id != "" and not clean_items.has(id):
73: 			clean_items.append(id)
74: 	if clean_items.is_empty():
75: 		return "方案里还没有装备"
76: 	if clean_items.size() > MAX_SLOTS:
77: 		clean_items = clean_items.slice(0, MAX_SLOTS)
78: 	var list: Array = _data.get(hero_name, [])
79: 	var idx := -1
80: 	for i in list.size():
81: 		if str((list[i] as Dictionary).get("name", "")) == clean_name:
82: 			idx = i
83: 			break
84: 	if idx >= 0:
85: 		list[idx] = {"name": clean_name, "items": clean_items}
86: 	elif list.size() >= MAX_SCHEMES:
87: 		return "该英雄最多保存 %d 套方案" % MAX_SCHEMES
88: 	else:
89: 		list.append({"name": clean_name, "items": clean_items})
90: 	_data[hero_name] = list
91: 	_flush()
92: 	return ""
93: 
94: 
95: static func delete_build(hero_name: String, build_name: String) -> void:
96: 	_ensure_loaded()
97: 	var list: Array = _data.get(hero_name, [])
98: 	for i in range(list.size() - 1, -1, -1):
99: 		if str((list[i] as Dictionary).get("name", "")) == build_name:
100: 			list.remove_at(i)
101: 	if list.is_empty():
102: 		_data.erase(hero_name)
103: 	else:
104: 		_data[hero_name] = list
105: 	_flush()
106: 
107: 
108: ## 是否存在某英雄的任何方案
109: static func has_builds(hero_name: String) -> bool:
110: 	return not get_builds(hero_name).is_empty()

新任务：单机选人 BP 增加「同队职责唯一」（每队 5 席 = 战士/法师/刺客/射手/辅助 各 1 名，不能重复）。任务板 task-20，请 team_task_get 读取后 claim（expected_revision 用返回值），完成后 complete。只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd（上次你写的 BP/加载界面已上线并通过验证，做增量即可）。

要点：
1) 新增 `_team_roles_taken(team) -> Array` 与 `_can_pick_hero(hero_name, team) -> bool`（合法/未被全场选走/本队无同职责；玩家未锁定时允许换职责，只要没被 AI 队友占用）。
2) `_ai_pick_current()`：候选只取本队未使用职责的英雄；极端无解回退任意未选英雄不崩；保持全局唯一。
3) 玩家点击：`_on_hero_card_clicked` 同职责冲突 → `_flash_tip("本队已有%s，不能重复职责" % role)` 且不改变当前选择；`_on_confirm` 再校验（预览期间队友 AI 可能选了同职责）→ 冲突 tip 且不锁定。
4) 视觉：英雄卡条中「本队已有该职责」的卡置灰 + 小字「本队已有<职责>」（区别于「已被选」），禁止点击；提示区补「每队每个职责限选 1 名英雄」。
5) 网络 host 与 `_create_team_ai(..., forced_heroes)` 路径不动。
验证：headless 无新增 SCRIPT ERROR；windowed 探针压小 sel_draft_time 跑完整 BP，打印双方 5 picks 的 role 集合必须=5 个不同职责；构造冲突（写 sel_ally_picks 模拟队友已选射手）→ 点射手英雄 → `_can_pick_hero("孙尚香",0)==false`、selected_hero_type 未变、tip 文案正确；截图 screenshots/select_role_lock.png；BP→加载→开局仍正常；日志 0 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent；探针删净。不要弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 实测 + 截图 + 结论。

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.
